newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos vetoes Manila Jockey franchise bill.
newsitem.headline: Ramos vetoes Manila Jockey franchise bill.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos said on Wednesday he vetoed a bill ratified by both houses of Congress extending the 25-year franchise of racetrack operator Manila Jockey Club Inc.
The bill was vetoed because of objections raised by the finance department, Ramos told reporters at his weekly news conference.
The finance department said it "poses strong reservations on a lower documentary stamp tax to be imposed on horse racing bets for exotic events."
The finance department objected to the bill because it cut to five centavos from 10 the documentary stamp tax on every peso bet on the races.
Horse racing in the country was already enjoying preferential treatment because income tax on the winnings had been lowered to 10 percent from 20, it said.
Manila Jockey Club's existing franchise expires in October.

The permit allows Manila Jockey to construct and operate one racetrack within the city of Manila or anywhere within the provinces of Bulacan, Cavite and Rizal in the northern island of Luzon. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
